v8_fork_specificity.NOTE: no v8 no-fork control exists (forensics MISSING cell)

M4_code_fact.kl_direction: FORWARD KL = KL(teacher || student): sum p_teacher * (log p_teacher - log p_student). MASS-COVERING: the student is penalised wherever the teacher has mass and the student does not, so every teacher tail bump is a positive-mass constraint on the student.
M4_code_fact.temperature: NONE. No temperature parameter exists on the exploiter-distill path (T=1 on both sides). The only sharpening knob is --distill-topk on the action path.
M4_code_fact.mask_interaction: neg = (action_mask - 1) * 1e9 is added to BOTH student and teacher logits before log_softmax/softmax, so both distributions normalise over the LEGAL set only and illegal-action mass is exactly 0 on both sides. The 'tail' is therefore the legal tail (mean 6.72 legal actions of 11 on the gen-era state set), never illegal-action leakage.
M4_code_fact.topk_truncation: p_t.topk(k) then renormalise over the kept set; k=1 gives a one-hot target whose KL form reduces to -log pi_student(a_teacher) (plain CE); k >= n_actions reproduces _distill_loss exactly.
M4_code_fact.awr_weight_asymmetry: THE ACTION PATH CARRIES AN EXTRA PER-ROW WEIGHT THE KL PATH DOES NOT: w = clamp(exp(|A_hat|/beta), max=20) with A_hat the minibatch-normalised advantage. _distill_loss uses a plain masked mean (w == 1). So R2-ACTION and R2-TOPK train at an effective dose >= their nominal coef, while R2-KL trains at exactly its coef. This inflates the action arms' dose, i.e. it is CONSERVATIVE against the finding that the action arm helps most.
M4_code_fact.gradient_at_init: Because every arm forked rev-1 final, the student IS the parent at step 0, so d(loss)/d(student logits) = (p_parent - q_target). That vector is what M2 decomposes.
